title: Hours Calculator: Time Between Two Times, Breaks & Overnight
description: Free hours calculator: enter a start time, end time and unpaid break to see hours worked per day, decimal hours for a time card, overnight shifts and gross pay.
lead: How many hours did you work between 9:00 AM and 5:30 PM? Enter your start time, end time and break to get hours and minutes, decimal hours for payroll, and an optional pay estimate.
